authorization.user_direction: First complete the research optimization, including quantified storage and numerical-dispersion sensitivity, and only then revise the paper.
authorization.validation_state: validation was explicitly unsealed for the contemporaneous v20 research closure; this audit reuses validation only under a separately frozen script and does not open test_id

purpose: Quantify whether a deliberately coarsened LWC-84 solve exhibits a disproportionately large radial high-spatial-frequency error relative to its aggregate field error when compared with the frozen high-fidelity LWC-84 teacher.
claim_scope: A passed audit supports numerical-dispersion sensitivity of the registered radial spectral metric and a coarse-versus-high-fidelity LWC-84 contrast. It does not establish that the teacher, CREST, or any neural operator is dispersion-free.

record_panel.selection: complete deterministic validation census for the routed uniform, layered, and marmousi families in source-index order

excluded_family.reason: not in the frozen routed-family contract used by v19-v22

teacher_contract.method: LWC-84 with top free surface and three-sided CFS-CPML
teacher_contract.interpretation: high-fidelity low-dispersion numerical reference, not exact or dispersion-free truth

coarse_solver_contract.method: LWC-84 with top free surface and three-sided CFS-CPML

metric_contract.aggregate_relative_l2: mean of complete space-time relative L2 over 480 records
metric_contract.family_relative_l2: mean of complete space-time relative L2 within each family
metric_contract.spatial_spectrum_relative_l2: 2-D FFT per frame with normalized radial bands low<=1/3, middle in (1/3,2/3], high>2/3; ratio of summed squared spectral error to summed squared teacher spectrum
metric_contract.receiver_panel: nine receivers at saved z-index 10 and evenly spaced x-indices 5 through 195
metric_contract.receiver_lag: full-trace cross-correlation with parabolic sub-sample peak refinement; traces below 1% of the record maximum receiver energy are excluded

execution_contract.reason_for_streaming: 480 dense predictions would require 31105537920 raw bytes and the remote volume had only about 47 GB free before execution
